title: FactorIA layered image (*.image.json)
description: The source of a picture: a canvas and a list of layers (pixels, fill, gradient, procedural texture, SVG, text, provider image, group, adjustment, indexed pixel art) with opacity, blend mode, masks, clipping and an offset. One CPU compositor draws it; the PNG a Sprite uses is baked next to it (hero.image.json -> hero.png) with a recipe in assets.json, so assets.regenerate remakes it and a changed source warns as stale. With `frames` and `tags` it is an animation: pixels and indexed layers have cels per frame and the bake is a sprite sheet whose clips are the tags. Errors name the file and the JSON pointer; docs/IMAGES.md explains the format, the colour rules and the blend modes.

format.description: File format identifier. Always "factoria.image/1"; may be left out.

background.description: Colour the canvas starts with, under the first layer (a colour with alpha 0 or no background gives a transparent canvas).

output.description: Project-relative PNG the document bakes to, ending in .png. Default: the document's own path with .image.json replaced by .png.

description.description: What the picture shows and what it is for.

frames.description: Makes the document an animation: one entry per frame, with how long it shows. Left out, the document is one still picture (and bakes a plain PNG). With frames, the bake is a SPRITE SHEET (one cell per frame, plus the extra cells a reverse, ping-pong or repeated tag needs) and `tags` become its SpriteAnimator clips. Each pixels / indexed layer shows its own picture in frame 0 and changes in later frames through `cels`.

duration.description: How long the frame shows, in milliseconds (1 to 60000).

tags.description: Named runs of frames. Each is a clip of the baked sheet, so a SpriteAnimator plays it by name (SpriteAnimator.clip, entity.spriteAnimator.play(name)).

name.description: The clip name; unique in the document.

direction.description: The order the frames play in. A ping-pong turns around at both ends without repeating the end frames.

repeat.description: How many times the tag plays; 0 loops for ever, 1 plays once (the clip is not a loop).

sheet.description: How the animated document bakes to a sprite sheet.

columns.description: Frames (cells) per row of the sheet; default ceil(sqrt(cells)).

layers.description: The layers, BOTTOM first: each layer is drawn over the ones before it.

palette.description: Palette the document's indexed layers are locked to: "style" (the style.palette of assets.json) or a list of 1 to 81 different opaque colours, each "#rrggbb" (any colour the engine reads) or {"name": ..., "color": ...}. The colour at position N is the index N; an indexed layer's rows write it as the Nth character of 0-9a-zA-Z!#$%&*+-/:;<=>?@^_~. Left out, an indexed layer uses the style palette; image.pixel / image.draw copy it in here the first time, so a later change of the style does not recolour the picture.

name.description: The name commands use for this colour ("skin"); unique ignoring case; not ".", "transparent" or "none".

color.description: The opaque colour: "#rrggbb" or [r, g, b] in 0..1.

ramps.description: Colour ramps of the palette: each is a list of at least two palette colours (index, name or colour) from the darkest to the lightest; a colour is in one ramp. A step of image.pixel / image.draw ({"step": -1}) follows the colour's ramp; a colour in no ramp steps to the nearest palette colour that is darker (lighter) in OKLab.

items.description: A palette colour: its index, its name or its colour.

layer.description: One layer. The fields that apply depend on `kind`: pixels and provider take `source` (pixels and indexed layers of an animated document also `cels`); fill `color`; gradient `gradient`; procedural `texture`; svg `source` or `svg`; text `text`, `font`, `size`, `color`, `align`, `lineHeight`; group `layers`; indexed `rows` (or a blank `width` x `height`) and `ai`; adjustment only `adjustments` (it applies them to everything below it and takes no `blend` or `effects`). A field a kind does not take is an error.

kind.description: pixels: a PNG of the project. fill: one colour. gradient: linear or radial colour stops. procedural: a texture made by the arguments of assets.generate_texture. svg: an SVG rasterized with the engine's rasterizer. text: text in an engine font. provider: a PNG made by an image provider (counts as AI-made). group: layers drawn together, then blended as one. adjustment: colour operations on everything below. indexed: pixel art stored as palette indices (`rows`), locked to the document's palette; it takes no masks, adjustments or effects, and image.paint / image.edit refuse it (use image.pixel / image.draw).

name.description: A label for people and tools; not used for drawing.

visible.description: false skips the layer (and hides the layers clipped to it).

opacity.description: 0 invisible, 1 opaque. Multiplies the layer's alpha.

blend.description: How the layer mixes with what is below: the W3C blend modes, on the stored (sRGB-encoded) values like Photoshop. hue, saturation, color and luminosity are the non-separable ones. Not for adjustment layers.

x.description: Moves the layer right by whole pixels from the top-left of the canvas (or of its group); may be negative.

y.description: Moves the layer down by whole pixels; may be negative.

clip.description: Clip to the opaque part of the layer below (the nearest layer that is not itself clipped). Not for the first layer of a list.

masks.description: Masks, multiplied together, in the layer's own coordinates (before x and y).

adjustments.description: Colour operations applied to the layer's pixels, in order, before the masks. For an adjustment layer: what it applies to everything below. Types: invert, brightness, levels, curves, hsv, posterize, quantize, dither, gradientMap, colorBalance, threshold.

effects.description: Operations applied after the masks, in order; they may change the layer's footprint. Types: colorOverlay, outline, stroke, dropShadow, outerGlow, innerGlow, blur, sharpen, noise, shade.

source.description: pixels and provider: a PNG of the project. svg: an .svg file of the project. Pixels sit at the layer's x and y. A pixels layer with `cels` may leave `source` out: it shows nothing in frame 0.

provenance.description: provider layer: where the picture came from. Recorded in assets.json for the PNG when it has no record there yet.

prompt.description: The prompt the picture was made from.

seed.description: Seed, when the provider takes one.

references.description: Reference images sent with the request.

license.description: License or terms of the picture.

color.description: fill: the colour. text: the colour of the letters.

width.description: fill, gradient: the size of the layer's box in pixels (default: the canvas). svg: the width the SVG is fitted into (aspect kept, centred). indexed without `rows`: the size of the blank layer.

height.description: fill, gradient: the height of the box (default: the canvas). svg: the height the SVG is fitted into. indexed without `rows`: the height of the blank layer.

gradient.description: gradient layer: the colour ramp. Interpolated on premultiplied colour, so a stop with alpha 0 fades out without tinting.

type.description: linear runs along `angle`; radial grows from `center`.

angle.description: linear: degrees, 0 runs from the top to the bottom, 90 from the left to the right.

center.description: radial: [x, y] as fractions of the layer's box.

radius.description: radial: 1 reaches the corners of the box (half its diagonal), 0.5 the middle of its sides.

stops.description: At least two, in order of `at`.

color.description: A colour: "#rrggbb", "#rrggbbaa", a name such as "white", or [r, g, b(, a)] with components in 0..1 (bytes if any is above 1). Used as stored: no conversion to linear light.

texture.description: procedural layer: the picture arguments of assets.generate_texture (preset, width, height, seed, color, accent, scale, roughness, tileable, vignette, angle, planks fields); width and height default to the canvas. Run docs.commands on assets.generate_texture for the presets.

preset.description: The material: paper, parchment, wood, planks, leather, fabric, stone, noise, gradient, radial, vignette...

svg.description: svg layer: the SVG text, starting with <svg ...>. Give this or `source`.

text.description: text layer: the text; \n starts a new line. One colour, no shaping or kerning.

font.description: text layer: "" (DejaVu Sans), "builtin:pixel", "builtin:serif", "builtin:hand", "builtin:blackletter", "builtin:display", or a project .ttf/.otf path.

size.description: text layer: the em height in pixels.

align.description: text layer: which side of the layer's x the lines hang from.

lineHeight.description: text layer: distance between baselines, in ems.

layers.description: group layer: its layers, bottom first. A group is drawn on a transparent canvas of its own, so a child's blend mode acts inside the group.

rows.description: indexed layer: the pixels as text, one string per row, one character per pixel, all rows equally long (the layer's size). '.' is transparent; 0-9a-zA-Z!#$%&*+-/:;<=>?@^_~ are palette indices 0, 1, 2, ...; an index beyond the palette is an error. Example: ["..11..", ".1221.", "..11.."]. Put at x and y.

ai.description: indexed layer: true when AI made these pixels; the baked PNG is then recorded as AI-made (image.layer.convert sets it when the source was AI-made).

cels.description: Animated documents: what a pixels or indexed layer shows from each listed frame on (frame 0 is the layer itself: its `source` / `rows`, x and y). Listed in increasing frame order, one cel per frame; a frame without a cel keeps showing the one before. Cels need `frames` in the document. For a pixels layer the items are {frame, source|link|empty, x?, y?, opacity?}; for an indexed layer {frame, rows|link|empty, x?, y?, opacity?}.

frame.description: The frame this cel starts at. It shows from there until the next cel of the layer (a frame with no cel of its own HOLDS the one before).

empty.description: The layer shows nothing from this frame.

link.description: Shows the same picture as the layer shows at that earlier frame (a linked cel: no copy, same place and opacity).

source.description: A PNG of the project: what the layer shows from this frame.

x.description: Where the cel's top-left corner lands; default: the layer's x.

y.description: Where the cel's top-left corner lands; default: the layer's y.

opacity.description: Multiplies the layer's opacity for this cel.

anyOf.description: A cel gives exactly one of `empty`, `link` and `source`; empty and link take no x, y or opacity.

frame.description: The frame this cel starts at. It shows from there until the next cel of the layer (a frame with no cel of its own HOLDS the one before).

empty.description: The layer shows nothing from this frame.

link.description: Shows the same picture as the layer shows at that earlier frame (a linked cel: no copy, same place and opacity).

rows.description: The picture as text rows (see the layer's `rows`); the rows of a cel may be a different size from the layer's.

x.description: Where the cel's top-left corner lands; default: the layer's x.

y.description: Where the cel's top-left corner lands; default: the layer's y.

opacity.description: Multiplies the layer's opacity for this cel.

anyOf.description: A cel gives exactly one of `empty`, `link` and `rows`; empty and link take no x, y or opacity.

mask.description: A mask multiplies the layer's alpha by its coverage (0 hides, 1 shows). Coordinates are the layer's own pixels.

type.description: pixels: a PNG (white shows, black hides, its alpha counts; outside it everything is hidden). rect and ellipse: a box (the ellipse is inscribed in it). polygon: corner points. path: SVG path data.

feather.description: Width of the soft edge in pixels (a Gaussian blur of the mask with sigma = feather / 2); 0 is a hard edge.

points.description: polygon: at least three [x, y] corners.

path.description: path: SVG path data, e.g. "M10 10 L90 10 L50 80 Z" (M L H V C S Q T A Z, absolute or relative). Filled with the nonzero rule; anti-aliased.

operation.description: One adjustment or effect: {"type": name, ...fields}. The fields depend on the type.

type.description: adjustments: invert, brightness, levels, curves, hsv, posterize, quantize, dither, gradientMap, colorBalance, threshold. effects: colorOverlay, outline, stroke, dropShadow, outerGlow, innerGlow, blur, sharpen, noise, shade. The keys of each are in docs/IMAGES.md; the error for a wrong key lists them.

amount.description: brightness: -1..1 added to red, green and blue. colorOverlay: 0..1, how far towards `color`. sharpen: 0..10. noise: 0..1. shade: 0..1, how much of the lighting is mixed in.

color.description: A colour: "#rrggbb", "#rrggbbaa", a name such as "white", or [r, g, b(, a)] with components in 0..1 (bytes if any is above 1). Used as stored: no conversion to linear light.

inWhite.description: levels: input white point, 0..1, above inBlack.

channel.description: levels, curves: rgb, red, green or blue.

points.description: curves: [[x, y], ...] 2 to 32 points, x increasing, both 0..1 (monotone cubic).

colorize.description: hsv: give every pixel the hue and saturation.

levels.description: posterize: 2..256 values per channel. dither: values per channel when there is no palette.

palette.description: quantize, dither: "style" (style.palette of assets.json) or a list of 1 to 256 colours.

space.description: quantize, dither: the colour space of "nearest": oklab (default) or rgb.

dither.description: quantize: none, bayer2, bayer4, bayer8, floydSteinberg or atkinson.

method.description: dither: none, bayer2, bayer4 (default), bayer8, floydSteinberg or atkinson.

strength.description: quantize, dither: 0..1 scale of the dither. shade: 0..32 slope of the alpha height map. outerGlow, innerGlow: 0..8.

stops.description: gradientMap: 2 to 64 {at, color}, at 0..1 not decreasing.

above.description: threshold: colour at or above the level (default white).

below.description: threshold: colour below the level (default black).

position.description: outline, stroke: outside, inside or center.

smooth.description: outline, stroke: true anti-aliases the edge of the stroke (boolean). shade: sigma 0..16 of the alpha height map (number).

mode.description: blur: gaussian or box. noise: mono or color.

radius.description: blur: sigma (gaussian, 0..64) or half-width (box). sharpen: sigma 0.1..32.

normalMap.description: shade: project path of a normal map PNG (tangent space, green up).

flipGreen.description: shade: the normal map has green down.

lightDirection.description: shade: degrees counter-clockwise from +x, default style.lightDirection, else 135.

elevation.description: shade: degrees above the layer, 1..90, default 45.

threshold.description: sharpen: differences below this (0..1) are left alone.
